verdict.rationale: Zulip's topic model is extensively documented (start-a-topic flow, per-topic isolation, inbox/recent-conversations views) and independently corroborated by long-time users who call the topic/thread separation a 'fundamentally superior model' for following busy channels without being overwhelmed. Some community reports note onboarding friction for non-technical users, but this doesn't contradict that conversations are organized by topic once adopted. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks or hands-on tests specifically measuring 'catch-up efficiency' rather than general praise of the topic model.
